short: Text, voice and avatar from ECoG in one participant hold as a demonstration; sensor and decoder are standard, and an LM trained on the test pool inflates the text result.
position: The paper changed the sensor (M05, 253-electrode high-density ECoG), the decoders (M06, CTC recurrent networks) and the output (M08, text, synthesized voice and avatar). M05 and M06 are standard: the text WER matches the [concurrent] intracortical system [@willett2023] at a higher rate but on a vocabulary about 120 times smaller (inference). M08 is the main addition but has the weakest evidence: listeners got 54.4% of words wrong on the 1,024-word set, and, as the authors state, the real-time avatar is animated from decoded audio. The strongest confound is the language model (M07), trained on the sentence pool that contains the test sentences.

open.item: Evaluator fix 8: add Littlejohn et al. (Nature Neuroscience, 2025), a streaming brain-to-voice decoder in the same participant and ECoG array, as [later] state of the art for M08/M05.
